# Shivam Behl

> Personal site and portfolio for Shivam Behl, Software Engineer II at Microsoft. Shivam builds dependable cloud services, backend platforms, distributed systems, and production observability.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://shivambehl.github.io/): Professional summary, contact details, and primary profile.
- [Portfolio](https://shivambehl.github.io/about/): Selected work in cloud systems, agentic AI alert automation, commerce platforms, and personal projects.

## Selected work

- [Fashion Intelligence System](https://shivambehl.github.io/about/projects/fashioninteligence/): Multi-modal fashion-trend prediction using e-commerce data, NLP, and computer vision; top-three national result at Flipkart GRiD.
- [NARAD disaster-relief publication](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2212420921000674): Published work on disaster coordination and sentiment analysis.
- [Flipkart experience](https://shivambehl.github.io/about/experience/flipkart/): Post-delivery services, cart, checkout, invoicing, and asynchronous-task platform work.
